title: Untouched Fluffy Vietnamese Chicken Pho Ga
description: A floral and fluffy Vietnamese dish featuring ground coriander, served in a stone bowl and wrapped in a banana leaf, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly pho ga is a nostalgic treat. It combines the richness of chicken with the simplicity of Vietnamese flavors.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the chicken breast, ground coriander, onion, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon sticks.
Pour in 4 quarts of water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Add the fish sauce and rice noodles to the pot and cook for 5 minutes or until the noodles are tender.
Prepare the banana leaves by cutting them into large squares and wiping them clean with a damp cloth.
To assemble the pho ga, place a portion of the noodles and chicken into each banana leaf square.
Spoon some of the hot broth over the top and serve immediately with a lime wedge on the side.
Serve the pho ga in a stone bowl for a traditional and rustic presentation.
